judge: thinking judge with one-sentence reason (run_variants.judge_with_reason), unchanged; the exact verifier only scores
execution: Arms run sequentially in arm_order, each alone on the fleet via inkling/arms.py (fresh admission with the shim sha and mem fraction below, prefix-cache flush, server counters, idle wait, GPU energy). Watchdog inkling/watch.sh; MemAvailable logged every 60 s.
resume_rule: If an arm stops on an infrastructure fault (runner stop flag, worker or judge infra failure, node fault), the fault is fixed and the same arm is continued with arms.py --resume-from (skips its cases that finished without infra faults; reruns the others with the same seeds) and documented as an amendment. Server tokens, wall and energy of an arm are then the sums over its segments (wasted work of the stopped segment included and reported separately). Never a silent restart; no case is dropped.
exclusions: None. All 96 cases of each arm count.

serving.launch: inkling/serve.sh, MEM=0.75 since 2026-11-21 16:25 Europe/Warsaw (KV ~1.08M tokens per node)
serving.adapter: inkling/shim.py (vLLM dialect; client disconnects close the upstream stream and count as shim:client_cancels)

concurrency_note: At most 4 agents in flight per case (add-on X: 8), 20 cases at once, per-endpoint slot cap 20 (agents and judges) <= 25.
generator: make_arithmetic_hard.py --seed 2026112317 --protocol arithmetic-hard-v17 --output datasets/arithmetic-hard-v17 (after these plans are committed and pushed); same rules as hard-v5..v16
baseline_note: Defaults: arithmetic roll12strategy (cap 12); coding R2 replacement. New in this study for all arms: worker research/xl-night-v1 (one retry on upstream transport loss, charged; byte-identical otherwise) and judge retry (runner night/round3).
design: Fable round 3 (IDEAS-swarm-round3-fable.md) ideas 1 (closers), 2 stage A (slots 12-19 on abstentions), 4 (end-of-budget recall) and the R2-6a leftover sentence; one default arm D, one paired prompt arm L, three add-ons on D's clean abstentions (an add-on cannot lose a case: gates are wrong answers and cost).
question: X (idea 2 stage A): slots 12-19 (current hint cycle, 8 in flight) on D's clean abstentions: does going past 12 agents rescue cases?
decision_rule: Cap 20 becomes the accuracy default (to be made load-gated in a stage-B study) if X rescues >= 2 of D's abstentions and 0 wrong; cap 16 instead if all rescues come from slots 12-15. Tokens and energy are reported (owner priority: quality).
report: inkling/report_round3_hard17.py -> results/swarm-round3-hard17-v1/REPORT.md + report.json (written before any hard-v17 data)
